note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. `hasFastAtrialFibrillation` requires maximumHeartRateBpm >= 150 — AF with a controlled ventricular rate below that threshold grades only moderate severity, not critical. Also notable: `F-UNEXPECTED-FINDING-001` checks only atrialFibrillationDetected/ventricularTachycardia/highGradeAvBlock, not a significant pause — so the critical persona below (whose only critical trigger is a >3s pause) never raises that flag even with no originating request linked.

personas.name: normal-24-hour-holter-complete
personas.description: A normal 24-hour ambulatory ECG for palpitations: predominant sinus rhythm, normal diurnal heart-rate variation, no pauses, ectopy, or tachyarrhythmia, every mandatory report section present — expect normal classification + none severity + 100% completeness + routine follow-up + no-action.

personas.name: abnormal-paroxysmal-af-controlled-rate-moderate-not-critical-complete
personas.description: A 7-day ambulatory ECG for intermittent palpitations detects paroxysmal atrial fibrillation with a controlled ventricular response (maximum rate 132 bpm, below the 150 bpm fast-AF threshold): AF alone grades only moderate severity via its own dedicated rule, and `hasFastAtrialFibrillation` requires a maximum rate of 150 bpm or more, so this stays well short of the critical pathway; report complete — expect abnormal classification + moderate severity (reportingCategory af-detected) + 100% completeness + recommended follow-up + further-monitoring.

state.clinicalHistory: Intermittent palpitations; 7-day ambulatory ECG to screen for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
state.comparisonWithPrevious: No previous ambulatory ECG on file.
state.findingsNarrative: Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation detected on two occasions, each lasting several hours, with a controlled ventricular response (maximum rate 132 bpm during AF). Symptoms of palpitation correlated with the AF episodes on diary review.
state.impression: Paroxysmal atrial fibrillation with a controlled ventricular response.
state.recommendedFollowUp: Refer to cardiology for consideration of rate/rhythm control and anticoagulation risk assessment (CHA2DS2-VASc).

expected.recommendedAction: Recommend cardiology follow-up or further monitoring as clinically indicated.

personas.name: critical-significant-pause-uncommunicated-incomplete
personas.description: A single sinus pause of 4.6 seconds recorded overnight, associated with a brief pre-syncopal episode: a pause exceeding the 3-second `SIGNIFICANT_PAUSE_SECONDS` threshold is a critical rhythm finding that auto-escalates classification to critical and follow-up to critical-alert regardless of the other axes; the result has not yet been recorded as communicated, no originating request is linked, and the clinical history and impression sections are not yet completed while urgent pacing assessment is arranged — expect critical classification + major severity + 60% completeness + critical-alert follow-up + urgent-review.

state.findingsNarrative: A single sinus pause of 4.6 seconds is recorded overnight, associated with a brief episode of pre-syncope reported in the patient diary. Underlying rhythm sinus throughout.
state.clinicianNotes: Phoned through to the on-call cardiology team immediately; patient advised to attend for urgent pacing assessment.
